title.zh: 将 Pagadian 市 Banale 描笼涯的 Pagadian 市综合中学改设为名为 Pagadian 市国立综合中学的国立综合中学并为其拨款
title.en: An Act Converting the Pagadian City Comprehensive High School in Barangay Banale, Pagadian City, Into A National Comprehensive High School To Be Known As the Pagadian City National Comprehensive High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Pagadian City Comprehensive High School in Barangay Banale, Pagadian City, Into A National Comprehensive High School To Be Known As the Pagadian City National Comprehensive High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Pagadian City Comprehensive High School in Barangay Banale, Pagadian City, is hereby converted into a national comprehensive high school to be known as the Pagadian City National Comprehensive High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Pagadian City Comprehensive High School are transferred to and absorbed by the Pagadian City National Comprehensive High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall take the necessary steps for the conversion and operation of the school and for the effective implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
